## Notes
- 2000: Semantics for the Web
- Author of several books on the semantic web; a second edition of *Ontology Engineering* is coming
- PhD thesis in 1996 ...
- GOFAI and NewFAI (Good Old Fashioned)
- paper in Journal of Web Semantics (2025)
- Data first to GenAI first approach
- consider Semantic sprinkles approach
- US Army Program. Collective Judgment Foundation ....
- RAG system architecture, gpt-oss-20b ...
- TMS Server
- <https://aiscientists.grailai.io/>
- RPI Hackathon, June 2026, Agentic Teaching Assistant
- Toastmasters

## What I take away

- Dinosaurus approach :-)
- Innovative agentic teaching assistant
